evals.prompt: A renter stops a streaming AI reply and loses an unsent draft. Diagnose the minimal change based on OpenMuse, naming current MDE files and required 390px tests.
evals.expected_output: Inspect current chat components and installed CopilotKit v2; model OpenMuse send/stop draft retention; propose focused change and real browser test, no new runtime. Acceptance criteria: Names src/components/chat/concierge-copilot-chat-view.tsx and related chat owner; Checks actual implementation against OpenMuse docs/EXPERIENCE.md before recommending changes; Preserves draft on stop and includes 390px proof; does not install React Native.

evals.prompt: The AI shows five rentals and a map, but two properties have missing coordinates. Use OpenMuse patterns to improve rich results.
evals.expected_output: Inspect existing chat card and map wiring; keep unknown coordinates without pins and grounded evidence; model source/error states from the upstream card. Acceptance criteria: Inspects current MDE cards and map instead of adding a search engine; Does not invent pins, prices, availability or images; Tests loading/empty/error/success and links/pin synchronization.

evals.prompt: Make chat show a readable error after a user stops a failing request. Which existing layers and official references matter?
evals.expected_output: Distinguish stop vs network failure in existing CopilotKit AG-UI chain and use official v2 docs and focused tests. Acceptance criteria: Verifies current runtime and v2 imports; Uses current upstream examples as models, not copied React Native runtime; Plans focused tests and does not invent a passed result.
